questions.question: Define modern marketing?
questions.solution_html:
• Modern marketing focuses on creating value for customers by understanding their needs and
  • building long-term relationships. It uses technology, data, and customer insights to deliver
  • personalised experiences. It moves beyond selling products to satisfying customer expectations.
questions.final_answer: personalised experiences. It moves beyond selling products to satisfying customer expectations

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of product photos in marketing.

questions.question: Question 5
questions.solution_html:
• Analyze how satisfaction leads to brand loyalty.

questions.question: Define customer journey mapping.

  • and interactions. This enables better service design and improved customer experience.

questions.question: Explain the speciality of Personas in marketing.

• Personas are fictional profiles representing different types of customers. They help marketers

  • effective marketing strategies.

questions.question: State the role of social media in marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Social media helps businesses reach large audiences quickly and engage customers through
  • interactive content. It supports brand awareness, customer feedback, and targeted advertising. It
  • also enhances customer relationships and drives sales.
questions.final_answer: also enhances customer relationships and drives sales

questions.question: Define mobile marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Mobile marketing involves promoting products and services through mobile devices like
  • smartphones and tablets. It uses SMS, apps, mobile ads, and location-based services to reach
  • customers instantly. It enables personalised and real-time communication.
questions.final_answer: customers instantly. It enables personalised and real-time communication
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Distinguish between intent-based and behaviour-based segmentation.
questions.solution_html:
• Intent-based segmentation groups customers based on what they plan or intend to buy in the future.
  • Behaviour-based segmentation classifies customers based on past actions such as purchases
  • browsing patterns, or usage frequency. Both help marketers target customers more effectively.
questions.final_answer: browsing patterns, or usage frequency. Both help marketers target customers more effectively
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Question 14
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse why ethical marketing practices are important in today's marketing scenario.
  • Ethical marketing practices build trust and credibility among customers, which is essential in a
  • competitive digital market. Consumers today are more aware and demand transparency in
  • communication. Ethical behaviour protects brands from legal issues and reputation damage. It
  • ensures long-term customer relationships based on honesty and fairness. Ethical marketing also
  • differentiates a brand from competitors who may use misleading tactics. Ultimately, it contributes
  • to sustainable business growth.
questions.final_answer: to sustainable business growth
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the significance of display ads in marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Display ads help businesses gain visibility by appearing on websites, apps, and social platforms.
  • They use visuals, animations, and short messages to attract customer attention. Display ads support
  • brand awareness even if users do not click immediately. They target audiences based on interests
  • behaviour, or demographics. Retargeting through display ads reminds users of products they
  • viewed earlier. This results in higher engagement and improved conversions.
questions.final_answer: viewed earlier. This results in higher engagement and improved conversions
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Question 16
questions.solution_html:
• Break down the components of a microenvironment and explain how each affects
  • decision-making.
  • The microenvironment consists of customers, competitors, suppliers, intermediaries, and the
  • company itself. Customers influence decisions because their preferences determine product
  • features and pricing. Competitors push the company to innovate and adopt better strategies.
  • Suppliers affect production quality, cost, and availability of materials. Intermediaries like
  • distributors and retailers influence how products reach customers. The company’s internal
  • environment—employees, departments, and culture—shapes marketing decisions and overall
  • performance.
questions.final_answer: performance
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: State the disadvantages of marketing.
questions.solution_html:
• Marketing can be expensive, especially with high costs for advertising and promotion. It may
  • increase product prices as companies pass promotional costs onto consumers. Sometimes
  • marketing can create misleading impressions if not done ethically. It may promote unnecessary
  • consumption and encourage materialism. Marketing activities also raise environmental concerns
  • by increasing packaging and waste. Businesses may face negative publicity if campaigns fail or
  • offend customers.
questions.final_answer: offend customers
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Evaluate the mobile marketing strategies available.
questions.solution_html:
• Mobile marketing strategies include SMS marketing, app-based marketing, push notifications
  • mobile ads, and location-based promotions. SMS marketing is effective for quick updates but can
  • feel intrusive. App-based marketing offers personalised experiences but requires users to install
  • the app. Push notifications drive engagement but must be used carefully to avoid irritation. Mobile
  • ads reach a wide audience but depend on user attention. Overall, combining strategies ensures
  • better reach and higher conversion rates.
questions.final_answer: better reach and higher conversion rates
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Identify the reasons modern marketing is considered more efficient than traditional
questions.solution_html:
• marketing.
  • Modern marketing uses digital tools that allow precise targeting of customers based on data. It
  • offers real-time analytics to measure performance instantly, unlike traditional methods. Costs are
  • lower because digital campaigns do not require physical materials. Customer engagement is higher
  • through social media, email, and mobile platforms. Personalised marketing improves customer
  • satisfaction and response rates. Overall, modern marketing provides better reach, speed, and
  • performance tracking.
questions.final_answer: performance tracking
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain customer journey mapping and its importance.
questions.solution_html:
• Customer journey mapping is a visual representation of all the interactions a customer has with a
  • brand. It includes stages like awareness, consideration, purchase, and post-purchase. The map
  • helps identify customer needs and expectations at each stage. It also highlights pain points or gaps
  • in service delivery. Businesses use this insight to improve the overall customer experience. This
  • leads to better satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term engagement.
questions.final_answer: leads to better satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term engagement
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Question 21
questions.solution_html:
• Compare the effectiveness of email campaigns.
  • Email campaigns are effective because they allow direct communication with customers at a low
  • cost. They offer personalisation through tailored content based on customer behaviour. Compared
  • to social media posts, emails provide deeper engagement and higher conversion rates. Email
  • performance can be tracked using open rates, click-through rates, and conversions. Automated
  • email sequences nurture customer relationships effectively. Overall, email campaigns remain one
  • of the most reliable digital marketing tools.
questions.final_answer: of the most reliable digital marketing tools
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Question 22
questions.solution_html:
• Touchpoints influence customers in perceiving a brand’s value, reliability, and emotional
  • resonance. Validate.
  • Touchpoints are moments when customers interact with a brand, such as websites, ads, customer
  • service, packaging, and social media. Each touchpoint shapes the customer's impression of the
  • brand’s value and quality. Positive interactions build trust and signal reliability. Emotional
  • touchpoints, like friendly support or inspiring content, strengthen emotional bonds. Inconsistent
  • or negative touchpoints can harm the brand image. Therefore, managing touchpoints effectively
  • is crucial for delivering a strong and consistent brand experience.
questions.final_answer: is crucial for delivering a strong and consistent brand experience
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
